component.name: DiscoveryTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "RunDiscovery" end sub
sub RunDiscovery() port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") sock = CreateObject("roDatagramSocket") if sock = invalid then m.top.results = [] return end if sock.SetMessagePort(port) group = CreateObject("roSocketAddress") group.SetAddress("239.255.255.250:3702") sock.SetSendToAddress(group) sock.SetMulticastTTL(2) sock.NotifyReadable(true)
found = {} order = [] clock = CreateObject("roTimespan") clock.Mark() timeoutMs = m.top.timeoutMs ' UDP is lossy and some cameras answer only one of the two probe ' types, so send both, and repeat once. SendProbes(sock) resent = false
while clock.TotalMilliseconds() < timeoutMs if not resent and clock.TotalMilliseconds() > 1200 then SendProbes(sock) resent = true end if msg = wait(200, port) if type(msg) = "roSocketEvent" and msg.GetSocketID() = sock.GetID() and sock.IsReadable() then text = sock.ReceiveStr(16384) sender = "" from = sock.GetReceivedFromAddress() if from <> invalid then sender = from.GetAddress().Split(":")[0] for each match in OnvifParseProbeMatches(text, sender) if not found.DoesExist(match.id) then order.Push(match.id) found[match.id] = match end for end if end while sock.Close()
results = [] for each id in order results.Push(found[id]) end for m.top.results = results end sub
sub SendProbes(sock as Object) info = CreateObject("roDeviceInfo") sock.SendStr(OnvifProbeMessage("dn:NetworkVideoTransmitter", info.GetRandomUUID())) sock.SendStr(OnvifProbeMessage("tds:Device", info.GetRandomUUID())) end sub
